import json, subprocess, pathlib
root = pathlib.Path("~/Coding/punt-labs/public-website")
files = [f for f in subprocess.run(["git","status","--short"],capture_output=True,text=True,cwd=root).stdout.split() if f.endswith(".jsonl")]
# map corrupt lines in the CURRENT (hand-scrubbed) versions
nuke = {}
for f in files:
    for i,l in enumerate((root/f).read_text(errors="replace").splitlines(),1):
        if not l.strip(): continue
        try: json.loads(l)
        except Exception: nuke.setdefault(f,[]).append(i)
# restore all from HEAD
subprocess.run(["git","checkout","--"]+files, cwd=root, check=True)
# nuke: drop tool_input, blank preview, mark redacted
tot=0
for f, lines in nuke.items():
    p = root/f
    ls = p.read_text().splitlines()
    for i in lines:
        obj = json.loads(ls[i-1])
        obj.pop("tool_input", None)
        if "tool_input_preview" in obj: obj["tool_input_preview"] = ""
        obj["redacted"] = True
        ls[i-1] = json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",",":"))
        json.loads(ls[i-1]); tot+=1
    p.write_text("\n".join(ls)+"\n")
print("restored", len(files), "files; nuked", tot, "secret-bearing lines:", {k:len(v) for k,v in nuke.items()})
EOF
